basic_info.description: Welcome to 518 15th Avenue - the home for you if location is of paramount importance!  Boasting a fantastic location and tremendous size on a wide lot, this flat is situated in a superb spot in the eastern edge of the Central Richmond District offering many options for its new owners. The lower home in a fully vacant two unit building, it has a gracious floor plan with a formal living room and dining room as well as two bedrooms with a third bedroom accessed via a hallway. Considerable period detail remains for extraordinary charm and character. The large garage has good scale and possible development potential. Blocks to hiking, biking and museums and activities in Golden Gate Park and The Presidio, and just a few miles to Ocean Beach. Near public and private transit options, including multiple bus lines and Park Presidio Boulevard to points north toward the Golden Gate Bridge and south to other San Francisco neighborhoods and cities on the peninsula. Retail services and establishments abound, in addition to restaurants and coffee shops of the Geary and Balboa corridors. For partners who want to initiate a new TIC? Or to buy the building to occupy as a family compound? Invest as an income property? The choice awaits its new owner.
